zh-CN.name: 企业微信助手
zh-CN.shortDesc: 在对话里代你操作企业微信：消息、文档、表格、日程、会议、待办、邮件、微盘
zh-CN.fullDesc:
企业微信助手把企业微信的日常办公搬进 DesireCore 的对话框。你用日常语言说出意图，它通过企业微信官方命令行工具 wecom-cli 把事情办成，再用可读的语言汇报结果——不必打开企业微信客户端，不必记接口，不必自己敲命令。

覆盖能力（14 类服务，95 个方法）：
- 消息与会话：查最近会话、拉取群聊记录、发送文本/图片/文件/语音/视频
- 在线文档：新建、导入、读取、追加与覆盖正文
- 在线表格：新建、导入、读改数据、追加行、子表管理
- 智能表格：子表/字段/记录/视图/图表的完整增删改查与行列样式
- 智能文档：创建、页面读取与管理、Block 编辑、内容追加与覆盖
- 文档管理：跨类型搜索、重命名、成员权限与加入规则
- 日程：增删改查、参与人管理、多人闲忙查询、会议室查询与预订
- 会议：预约、查询、搜索、取消、更新参会人、读取纪要与转写
- 待办：创建、查询、更新、完成、删除、分派参与人
- 邮件：发送、回复、转发、搜索与正文读取
- 微盘：搜索、上传、下载、重命名、读元信息、新建文件夹
- 通讯录：按姓名/拼音/别名解析成员
- 媒体文件：本地文件与企微之间的上传下载

风险治理：
发消息、发邮件、改文档权限、覆盖或删除内容等 26 个对外可见或不可逆的操作，一律先向你复述影响并取得明确同意才执行。文档加入规则涉及企业外可见时会额外提示。所有内部标识（成员 ID、会话 ID、文档 ID 等）只在内部流转，回复中始终使用姓名、群名、文档标题这类可读信息。

能力边界（真机实测得出）：
机器人可以读取你的数据，但只能写入或修改机器人自己创建的内容——你自己建的文档、日程、待办，助手改不了，它会说明这条边界并给出替代方案。企业微信的机器人权限按品类逐项开通，未开通时助手会把官方开通指引原样转给你，不会反复重试。

使用前提：
需要 Node.js 18+ 与企业微信账号。首次使用时助手会引导你安装 wecom-cli 并用企业微信扫码完成授权，仅需一次。

en-US.name: WeCom Assistant
en-US.shortDesc: Operate WeCom from chat: messages, docs, sheets, calendar, meetings, todos, mail, drive
en-US.fullDesc:
WeCom Assistant brings everyday WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) work into the DesireCore chat box. You state your intent in plain language; it gets the job done through the official WeCom CLI and reports back in readable terms — no need to open the WeCom client, memorize APIs, or type commands yourself.

Coverage (14 services, 95 methods):
- Messaging: list recent sessions, pull group chat history, send text/image/file/voice/video
- Docs: create, import, read, append and overwrite content
- Sheets: create, import, read/modify data, append rows, manage subsheets
- Smart sheets: full CRUD over subsheets, fields, records, views and charts, plus row/column styling
- Smart pages: create, read and manage pages, edit blocks, append and overwrite content
- Doc management: cross-type search, rename, member permissions and join rules
- Calendar: full schedule CRUD, attendee management, multi-member free/busy, meeting room booking
- Meetings: book, query, search, cancel, update attendees, read minutes and transcripts
- Todos: create, query, update, finish, delete, assign participants
- Mail: send, reply, forward, search and read message bodies
- Drive: search, upload, download, rename, read metadata, create folders
- Contacts: resolve members by name, pinyin or alias
- Media: move files between your machine and WeCom

Risk governance:
26 operations that are externally visible or irreversible — sending messages or mail, changing document permissions, overwriting or deleting content — always restate their impact and require your explicit consent first. Join-rule changes that would expose a document outside the company get an extra warning. Internal identifiers never appear in replies; you always see names, group titles and document titles.

Capability boundary (verified on a live account):
The bot can read your data but may only write or modify content the bot itself created — documents, schedules and todos you created yourself cannot be modified; the assistant explains this boundary and offers an alternative. WeCom bot permissions are granted per category; when a category is not enabled the assistant relays the official activation guidance verbatim instead of retrying.

Requirements:
Node.js 18+ and a WeCom account. On first use the assistant walks you through installing wecom-cli and authorizing once by scanning a QR code in WeCom.
